title: amomum heyneanum
intro: Amomum heyneanum, commonly known as Indian cardamom, is a type of plant that belongs to the Zingiberaceae family. The health benefits of Amomum heyneanum include its use as a carminative, helping to relieve symptoms of indigestion and gas, as well as its potential to lower blood sugar levels and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. Therapeutically, Amomum heyneanum is often used to treat conditions such as nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea, and it is also used in traditional medicine to treat fever and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Amomum heyneanum include compounds like cardamom oil, which contains a combination of alpha-pinene, limonene, and linalool, among other bioactive molecules.
